profile.size: Relatively common at 50-75 lb and can exceed 100 lb
profile.diet: Almost totally fish: mackerels, butterfishes, scads, jacks, flying fish; a little squid
profile.swimming_depth: Mostly in the upper mixed layer. Tagging off Baja California found an average depth of about 18 m, with 99% of daytime above the thermocline.
profile.behavior: Solitary or in very small loose groups. More common near banks (lumps), drop-offs or weed lines in blue water, along current edges and temperature breaks. Not warm-blooded.

factors.value_notes: Louisiana Sea Grant: wahoo are more common near banks (lumps), drop-offs and weed lines. Angler accounts focus on steep ledges where depth contours stack close together. Scored relative to the steepest offshore slopes in the area; the 2 km grid smooths small ledges away.
factors.reason_template: The seafloor drops steeply here ({value} m of depth change per km), one of the sharper ledges in the area.

factors.value_notes: Tagging of four wahoo in the Florida Straits (FAU) found the optimal swimming temperature started near 23.1 C. Angler sources give about 22-27 C as the best band. Sources disagree on the upper edge, so the ideal band is an estimate.
factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside the {ideal_min}-{ideal_max} C range where wahoo are most active.

factors.value_notes: Anglers fish wahoo along temperature breaks and current edges, especially where they meet a steep ledge. Scored relative to today's sharpest offshore breaks.
factors.reason_template: Water temperature changes about {per10km} C every 10 km here, one of the sharper breaks in the area today.

factors.value_notes: Wahoo are blue-water fish that do not live near shore. Cells shallower than 30 m are excluded. Bottom depth is a weak guide because the fish swim in the upper water column.
factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, in the blue water wahoo use.

factors.value_notes: Angler sources call November to February prime wahoo season off the Keys and Miami. Other sources say wahoo are caught year-round with a late-summer to early-fall peak in some regions. The window here is a judgment call.

value_text.peak: It is prime wahoo season (about November to February) off South Florida.
value_text.in_season: It is wahoo season off South Florida (about October to March).
value_text.off: It is outside the usual wahoo peak, though wahoo are caught year-round.

factors.value_notes: Wahoo patrol current edges. Planned with current data.
